summary: Critical gap: Workflow references test files (tests/LabelAssigner.Tests.ps1, tests/InvokeLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1) and fixture files (fixtures/label-rules.json) that don't exist—violates core TDD requirement to write tests first. Workflow will fail immediately. Production code is solid (proper Set-StrictMode, error handling, modular LabelAssigner module, meaningful validation messages), but missing test infrastructure makes it non-functional and unmaintainable. Workflow should be validated with actionlint before shipping. Test harness logic is sound but incomplete without test/fixture files.
